text:
Tara (People Ops): Quick alert  Niamh O'Connell (hire ID 50721) started in Dublin on 08/01 and HRIS shows her country as IE, tax status Non-US. Payroll export shows US federal & state withholding on her first pay (08/01-08/15). Can payroll look?
Evan (Payroll): That shouldn't happen. Can you paste the payroll line?
Tara (People Ops): Sure:
```
Period: 08/01-08/15
Name: Niamh O'Connell (50721)
Gross: 2,800.00 EUR (mapped as 2800.00 USD in payroll export)
Tax withheld: $420.00 (federal/state)
Net: $2,380.00
Paycode: EMPLOYEE_US
Country: US
```
Rory (HRIS): Her BambooHR record is correct: location Dublin, country IE, payroll_profile: INTERNATIONAL-IE. The overnight sync to payroll on 07/31 succeeded. I'm seeing an older placeholder profile (NEWHIRE-STAGING) in the payroll system attached to her record that slipped through; looks like the onboarding flow left a temp mapping when offer desk created an interim payroll stub.
Evan (Payroll): Ok that explains the US paycode. We need to: 1) reverse the US withholdings, 2) issue a corrected paystub and make a gross/net correction in the local payroll ledger, 3) ensure local Irish payroll gets the correct amounts (subject to Irish PAYE/PRSI rules) OR coordinate with local payroll provider if we're not running IE payroll yet.
Priya (Benefits): She hasn't elected benefits yet; benefits enrollment won't take effect until 09/01 for European hires. No retro premiums.
Liam (Finance): I need the exact tax amounts reversed so we can correct GLs. Evan, estimate the withholding split and employer-side costs. Also flag if any cross-border payroll tax payments occurred (we need to reverse filings if HMRC/GOV.UK interface touched it).
Evan (Payroll): Quick check: $420 was taken off as US withholding. Employer taxes showing $130. I'll run a precise reverse calculation and check AP/filing queue.
payroll-bot: Created ticket PR-2024-3357 (N. O'Connell - wrong jurisdiction withholding).
Evan (Payroll): PR-2024-3357 created. I'm placing a reversing off-cycle to credit the $420 back and mark the line as "erroneous US withholding; converted to IE payroll". Before I post, two policy questions: 1) Do we reimburse any FX fees / exchange difference to Niamh? Her net showed USD amounts and she noticed a small shortfall in EUR. 2) Who owns final payroll in IE — internal payroll or local partner?
Tara (People Ops): Good Q. For FX, People Ops policy is to make the employee whole for errors caused by our systems; payroll should top up any small FX shortfall. For the IE payroll owner, we onboarded with LocalPay Solutions for Ireland starting 08/01 (email chain on People Ops). LocalPay should be the final payer; payroll needs to send them the corrected gross and confirm with their AP.
Rory (HRIS): I'll remove the interim NEWHIRE-STAGING mapping and add a guard so staging profiles with payroll_profile != INTERNATIONAL-IE don't get promoted to production. I'll also tag the hire record with a note referencing PR-2024-3357.
Evan (Payroll): Draft plan: 
- Hold any onward US tax filings for that period and check submission status.
- Post reversing off-cycle: credit $420 to employee net (one-time top-up to make whole in EUR after FX).
- Post employer tax reversal/adjustment $130 to ER payroll expense.
- Send corrected payroll export to LocalPay with final gross 2,800 EUR for IE PAYE processing.
- Attach corrected stub to ticket and notify Finance.
Liam (Finance): Please include journal entries: debit payroll liability $420; credit cash/AP as appropriate; debit ER payroll tax $130; credit payroll expense. Also include FX variance line if any top-up needed.
Niamh (New Hire): Thanks for the quick heads up team I was surprised to see USD on my portal. Happy to wait for corrected stub, appreciate you fixing it.
Evan (Payroll): Posted reversing off-cycle and FX top-up queued. ETA 16:00 BST. Attaching note: "Mistaken US withholding reversed; employee to be paid via LocalPay IE; payroll mapping corrected."
payroll-bot: Off-cycle reversal posted for 50721; PR-2024-3357; timestamp 1717008950.
Tara (People Ops): Thanks everyone. Rory please follow up with Eng/Onboarding to prevent interim staging profiles from making it into production exports. Liam Finance will confirm GL codes after stub attached. Closing loop once LocalPay confirms receipt.
